relations.reading: The field series suggests treating connectivity, institutional capacity and existing fleets as integration inputs for Mobility OS rather than as exceptions to an ideal platform.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: Read the engineering case alongside this field note to distinguish the architectural mechanism from the territorial learning that shaped its deployment.

relations.title: Compatibilidad global
relations.reading: Analog pooling can inspire a routing model, but xSeil's fully committed demand requires preserving service obligations rather than selecting only the easiest demand to serve.

relations.title: Conocimiento de dominio
relations.reading: The regional supplier fabric can be read alongside GEPLAN's field laboratory as capability formation through repeated operational problems, not simply technology adoption from outside.

relations.title: Signo de la desviación
relations.reading: The companion bridge note qualifies Lesson 6: preserve the capability that works under constraint, while testing its architecture rather than treating scarcity itself as a design advantage.

relations.title: Propuesta y compromiso
relations.reading: Tuxpan provides a field example of coordinating existing mobility capacity through rights and signals, while the current Product Annex states the scope of today's platform.

relations.title: Activación entre tipos de frontera
relations.reading: The Tuxpan mobility account illustrates cross-frontier activation through adaptation: experience from different operating worlds informed a locally constrained architecture.
